Choose the topic you need. Each reference defines the accepted inputs, returned data and failure conditions for its API.

## Tutorials {#goal-tutorials}

For a complete calculation, start with [the tutorial index](examples.qmd). The beginner tutorials cover [capacitance](tutorials/capacitance/prepare.qmd) and [resonance with EPR](tutorials/resonance-epr/prepare.qmd).

## Model and materials {#model-materials}

- [Geometry and SGB](geometry-sgb.qmd)
- [Physical representations](specs/physical-representation.qmd)
- [Material realization](specs/material-realization.qmd)

## Conductors and ports {#conductors-ports}

[Working with your own model](course/working-model.qmd) explains Net and port declarations. [AEDT inputs](course/aedt-inputs.qmd) covers GDS-backed models, and the [AEDT runtime reference](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd) defines the supported solver families.

## Mesh and adaptation {#mesh-adaptation}

Use the [mesh quality reference](mesh-quality.qmd) for stored-mesh diagnostics and the [prepared-model guide](course/solver-observations.qmd) to inspect inputs before execution.

## Execution and handoff {#execution-handoff}

[Execution profiles](execution-profiles.qmd) define simulation packages and launch controls. [Run a prepared model](course/execute.qmd) shows the commands.

## Results and reports {#results-reports}

The [report model](report-model.qmd) defines quantities, units and availability. [Read returned results](course/returned-results.qmd) shows how to load and interpret a result.

## Saved fields and offline loss {#saved-fields-offline-loss}

[Saved AEDT fields](course/aedt-saved-fields.qmd) let you evaluate EPR from an existing field solution. [Offline loss analysis](course/offline-epr.qmd) changes loss assumptions on recorded EPR results.
